headline: Austrian AgTech Firm Pessl Instruments to Install 15,000 Smart Weather Stations in Kenya
summary: Austrian agricultural technology company Pessl Instruments plans to install 15,000 smart weather stations in Kenya as the initial phase of a larger project targeting 100,000 stations.
why: AgTech investments and hardware deployments in emerging agricultural markets drive technological infrastructure growth and commercial expansion.

impacts.name: Pessl Instruments
impacts.why: Large international deployment contracts expand the company's operational footprint and revenue base.
